artGroup: Liruf, Zara, Dr. Rho and Dina, the four mentors, together
aiNote: Zara, Dr. Rho, Liruf and Dina are MentorAI: an artificial intelligence, not a person.

zara.name: Zara
zara.line: Curious and direct. She asks why until it all makes sense.

rho.name: Dr. Rho
rho.line: Patient and orderly. He explains with examples from everyday life.

liruf.name: Liruf
liruf.line: Playful and restless. He would rather try things than read about them.

dina.name: Dina
dina.line: Calm and attentive. She celebrates every step, however small.

age.label: Your age
age.tooYoung: LittleFounders starts at age 6. See you when you turn 6!
age.tooOld: {age}? You would be the oldest founder in history. What is your real age?

name.label: Name
name.notAllowed: That name can't be used here. Try your first name or a nickname.

welcome.title: Hi! We are your mentors
welcome.text: We help you learn how money works, one small step at a time. First, let's get to know each other.

age.title: How old are you?
age.text: We ask so that everything fits your age.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.text: Your first name or a nickname is enough.

mentor.title: {name}, choose your mentor
mentor.text: One of us goes with you everywhere. You can change later.

lessons.title: Nice to meet you, {name}. This is how you learn here
lessons.text: With short lessons where you do things, not just read: you move, choose and try, and I am right beside you.

games.title: You also play
games.text: Mini-games to practise what you learned. You have fun, and the learning comes along.

mentoria.title: Ask me anything
mentoria.text: Something in a lesson you did not get, something you heard and want to understand, an idea you want to build. I follow what you learn and guide you from there.

seeds.title: You earn Seeds
seeds.text: Seeds are the currency of LittleFounders. You earn them by learning and playing. They are not real money.

tasks.title: Tasks and rewards
tasks.text: I give you tasks, and so can your parent or guardian. Every task says who it comes from. If your parent or guardian joins you here, they can see your progress.

join.title: {name}, save your progress
join.text: Create your account and what you chose stays with you on any device. Creating it is free.

welcome.title: Hello! We are the mentors of LittleFounders
welcome.text: We go with your children while they learn how money works. Let us show you what you get as a parent.

age.title: How old are you?
age.text: We ask so that we show you the right things.

minor.title: This part is for parents and guardians
minor.text: No problem. There is a place made for you, and we are in it too.

mentor.title: {name}, choose your mentor
mentor.text: It goes with you too. Each of your children chooses their own.

child.title: Nice to meet you, {name}. This is what your child gets
child.text: Lessons to learn by doing, mini-games to practise, MentorAI for every question, and Seeds as rewards.

family.title: Family control
family.text: You add your children yourself, give them tasks and decide their rewards.

progress.title: See how they learn
progress.text: Follow each child's progress: what they finished, what they are practising and where they need a hand.

suggestions.title: A suggestion every day
suggestions.text: Ideas to talk about money at home and to keep your child going, based on what your child learns and practises on LittleFounders.

join.title: {name}, save your place
join.text: Create your account now. Adding your children comes next, and creating it is free.

saved.text: {name}, what you chose is saved on this device.
saved.textNoName: What you chose is saved on this device.
saved.continue: Pick up where I left off
saved.cleared: Erased. Nothing is saved on this device.
